description: The Global Publishers body reports a daladala service stoppage at Sabasaba but does not state that drivers/owners physically assembled as a public group or provide human turnout. Whether a gathering occurred, its size, and physical onset are unknown.
required_followup: Use accessible independent contemporary reporting or a public record to verify whether a public gathering occurred, establish any human turnout and its physical onset, and do not infer attendance from vehicles.

description: The January 13 report does not establish when the stoppage physically ended or service resumed.
required_followup: Find a dated account of departure/resumption or keep end_date null.

description: The explicit requests concern terminal infrastructure and space allocation; the existing demand categories do not directly cover these demands, and the article does not expressly request a fee reduction.
required_followup: Retain the textual demand and check the existing taxonomy before assigning any category; do not force a match.

description: No state response to the drivers' demands is established. The city director's refusal to comment to a reporter is not proof of ignoring or refusing the protesters.
required_followup: Seek direct evidence of negotiation, reception, enforcement, or physical crowd response; otherwise preserve unknowns.

description: Three distinct leads about the Dodoma daladala stoppage were inaccessible: Mwananchi returned HTTP 403; ITV returned browser cache misses, a default DNS failure, and then HTTP 403 on one escalated exact-URL request; IPP Media returned HTTP 403. None of these bodies was read.
required_followup: Respect each denial. Continue only with distinct accessible sources; do not retry, bypass, or seek mirrors, and do not treat search-result leads as corroboration.

description: Searches covered broad and weekly English terms plus Swahili, Zanzibar, Dodoma, and several sector terms. Results were heavily mixed with 2001 election material and recent events; rural, district-level and independent local-source coverage remains uneven.
required_followup: Continue region/sector searches and explicitly record language, geographic, archive, and web-index limits. Do not infer that no other gatherings occurred.

description: Open-web searching does not reproduce the original LexisNexis newspaper expansion and date filters may be ignored.
required_followup: Report this method difference and do not claim exhaustive coverage.

description: A February 2 report concerns a planned nationwide truck/bus strike over alleged police brutality and states it did not take place; no coordination with the January 13 Sabasaba daladala stoppage is evidenced.
required_followup: Keep the reports and demands separate unless direct evidence establishes a common organizer or continuous episode.
